the resource model of depletion may be too simplistic and that a more nuanced model of depletion may better explain the current empirical findings.

The main takeaway from our work is that
self-control is a multifaceted phenomenon, and a mechanistic account of its depletion should be equally multifaceted.
the resource model of ego depletion should not be taken as an account of the underlying mechanism but rather as a heuristic device for organizing the empirical evidence.
the resource model has been a powerful heuristic that has led to a large body of work, but it is time to move on.
